countersubjects.notes: no countersubject in exposition; one introduced later (type 1 of Group 6)

subject.ends: uncertain: one commentator says one note; could end at first note of bar 2 (like I.17, on dominant not in dominant key); Groocock prefers ending with the c#'' just before end of bar 2 (mediant), since the pattern of rising fourths and falling thirds continues; seven of fifteen entries support this
subject.answer: tonal (discussed in ch. 2); a real answer would sound like a sudden move to V and prevent the interval pattern continuing into bar 2

claims.claim: Four main divisions: opening section in triplets ending in V at bar 20; new beginning with running countersubject; return of opening material reduced to one-third; return of second section reduced to one-third
Subject regarded as ending with c#'' before end of bar 2 (mediant); seven of fifteen entries support this
Bars 20-22 codetta or introduction to the 'chief event', the countersubject at 23
Bars 45-49 almost exactly recapitulate 17-20 in the tonic; coda starts by repeating episode 1 (29-30); from 51 upper voices interchange upper voices of 46-48 (after Tovey)
